content: Salon launched 31 years ago as one of the first online-only news magazine outlets, and it announced today in an unsigned post that it’s ceasing publication. The company said that the “business realities of independent digital journalism have changed profoundly over the years,” and it decided that its publishing model is “no longer sustainable.” It didn’t go into detail about why, but many websites are grappling with “Google Zero” and the impact of AI tools. When reached for comment, Salon general manager Amanda Wolfe pointed The Verge to today’s announcement post. “Thirty-one years is a remarkable run, but what matters most is what happened during those years: the journalism, the ideas, the voices, the conversations and the community that grew around them,” Salon said in its post. “Salon helped demonstrate what digital journalism could be and could become. We hope that legacy will continue to matter long after today.” On Bluesky, Salon chief content officer Erin Keane says that the editorial archive will “stay live for now.” Current Salon owner Find.co acquired Salon in 2023 and describes itself as a “Performance Marketing Ecosystem transforming crypto marketing with performance and precision.”

chineseContent: Salon 于 31 年前推出，是最早的在线新闻杂志网站之一，今天在一篇未署名的帖子中宣布停止出版。该公司表示，“多年来独立数字新闻的商业现实已经发生了深刻的变化”，并决定其出版模式“不再可持续”。它没有详细说明原因，但许多网站正在努力应对“谷歌零”和人工智能工具的影响。当联系到 Salon 总经理阿曼达·沃尔夫 (Amanda Wolfe) 寻求评论时，The Verge 指出今天发布的公告。 “三十一年是一段非凡的历程，但最重要的是那些年里发生的事情：新闻、想法、声音、对话和围绕它们成长的社区，”沙龙在帖子中说。 “沙龙帮助展示了数字新闻可能是什么以及可能成为什么。我们希望这一遗产在今天之后的很长一段时间内仍然发挥着重要作用。”在 Bluesky 上，沙龙首席内容官艾琳·基恩 (Erin Keane) 表示，社论档案将“暂时保留”。 Salon 目前的所有者 Find.co 于 2023 年收购了 Salon，并将自己描述为“通过绩效和精确度改变加密营销的绩效营销生态系统”。
